codebook.column: Numerical column5 of Texts: first digit following four-digit reference

method: Every selected reference and its first full metadata code was visually read in the primary Texts page image. Existing fullbook OCR located pages but was not authority for transcription.
All six printed metadata digits are retained in order with layout spacing collapsed; first digit is object type, second side, fifth line. Digit strings are not integers so zeros are preserved.
Types were not inferred from reference ranges, candidate object codes, text length, material assumptions, or U-bearing side position.
Only first printed side/line is recorded. Metadata direction from that line is not propagated to all recovered lines.
Rows on each whole-page image are located by exact printed reference. No unseen intervening rows were classified.

limitations: Catalogue object labels are authenticated; independent modern classification, material and excavation context have not been re-established.
This selection is conditioned on recovered M328-bearing lines, not an unbiased sample of all Harappan objects.
One catalogue reference is the counting unit here and is not automatically a unique independent physical artifact.
No glyph reading, quantity value, administrative function or numerical semantics established by object-type classification.
